chains.name: cargo drop

steps.title: Open the way in
steps.what: Board, then get past the motion sensor doors: four of them (BP_InteractiveDoor_Walker_01_C_11, BP_InteractiveDoor_Walker_01_C_17, BP_InteractiveDoor_Walker_01_C_18, BP_InteractiveDoor_Walker_01_C_21) stay shut until their 4 weak points each are shot; breakable panels open when the weak point wired to them is shot; the bridges and climbable arrays are moved by their interaction points.
steps.inferred: which doors stand between boarding and the cores is a matter of the ship's layout (scene.json); the wiring only says what opens each

steps.title: Expose and destroy the 5 relay power cores
steps.what: Destroy the shields of BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_7, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_3, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_4, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_5, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_8 (850 health each, shot on their ring; the shields of BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_7, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_4, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_8 can also be breached by hand, Breach Power Core, 5 s). Each core then powers the hatch relay BP_PuzzleRelay_Triple_C_1, which opens one of its 6 hatch pairs per input.
steps.inferred: the core powers out once all its shields are destroyed (NumShieldsRemaining)

steps.title: Raise and break the breachable core (the sixth relay input)
steps.what: Three raiders hold the three "Move Up" interactions of BP_Frigate_BreachableCore_C_1 together (its InteractionCoordinatorComponent), the core rises (MoveUpAnimation, C_FrigatePowerCore_Extention), then its 4 shields (BP_FrigatePowerCoreShield_C_29, BP_FrigatePowerCoreShield_C_21, BP_FrigatePowerCoreShield_C_30, BP_FrigatePowerCoreShield_C_20, breach disabled at start, so shot) are destroyed and it powers the relay.
steps.alternatives: steps 2 and 3 are independent: any order
steps.inferred: the order rise-then-shields and that all three interactions must be held together come from the names (coordinator with three interactions, MoveUpAnimation, AttahedPowerCoreShields)

steps.title: The hatch relay opens the hull gate
steps.what: With all 6 inputs in (BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_7, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_3, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_4, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_5, BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_8, BP_Frigate_BreachableCore_C_1), BP_PuzzleRelay_Triple_C_1 powers the hull gate BP_FrigateHull_Gate_C_2, which in turn powers all four cargo latches (BP_FrigateHull_Gate_C_2 -> BP_Frigate_CargoLatch_C_5, BP_Frigate_CargoLatch_C_7, BP_Frigate_CargoLatch_C_6, BP_Frigate_CargoLatch_C_4).
steps.inferred: ActivationsRequired is the native default: that the relay needs all 6 inputs is inferred from its 6 hatch pairs

steps.title: Power each latch with its own power core
steps.what: Each latch has a second power input, a power core of its own: BP_Frigate_CargoLatch_C_5 <- BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_5; BP_Frigate_CargoLatch_C_7 <- BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_8; BP_Frigate_CargoLatch_C_6 <- BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_6; BP_Frigate_CargoLatch_C_4 <- BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_9. BP_Frigate_CargoSideDoor_01_C_2 opens with BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_8; BP_Frigate_CargoSideDoor_01_C_3 opens with BP_FrigatePlatform_Beams_02_C_5.
steps.alternatives: any order, and in parallel with steps 2 to 4
steps.inferred: a latch is ready when both inputs (hull gate and its core) are in: its MultiPowerComponent count is the native default

steps.title: Breach the four latches, two raiders each
steps.what: On each latch two raiders hold "Breach" on Interaction A and Interaction B together (raider tool equipped) for 1.5 s (coordinator InteractionCompletionTime); the latch swings open (Latch Sequence, C_CargoLatch_Rotation_Narrow). Quest: Frigate Special Cargo Latch.
steps.inferred: that the latch accepts the breach only once powered (bRequirePowerActivation is unset on the latch, native default)

steps.title: Power the cargo gate and the ratchet
steps.what: Destroy the shields of BP_FrigatePowerCore_C_9 (BP_FrigatePowerCoreShield_C_39, BP_FrigatePowerCoreShield_C_25); the core powers the cargo gate BP_FrigateHull_Gate_C_3, which powers the ratchet BP_Frigate_CargoRatchet_C_1 (bRequirePowerActivation true: its interactions wait for this power).

steps.title: Work the ratchet, two raiders, four pulls
steps.what: Two raiders hold Ratchet Interaction A and B together; the coordinator (RepeatUpToTally) needs 4 completions (InteractionCompletionTime 1 s, ResetTime 1 s), each one steps the pillars (First..Fourth Step, 1.5 s each, 150 cm per step by the C_Ratchet_Translation curves; StepDelay 2.2 s).
steps.inferred: what a pull does is read from the sequence and curve names

steps.title: The cargo drops
steps.what: When all four latches are open, the ratchet waits LatchesCompleteToReleaseDelay (2 s) and plays its Release sequence (C_Ratchet_Release, 10 s): the cargo BP_PreciousCargo_C_1 is jettisoned (OnPayloadJettisoned) and flies to a drop site.
steps.inferred: whether the four ratchet pulls are needed before the release or only gate the pillars is not in the files; both are wired to the release (ratchet interactions and SoftLatchActors)
